Employment Details Position: Sales Representative - Industrial Safety Equipment Term: Permanent Working Hours: Monday to Friday : 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. Job Summary Our client is seeking an experienced, customer-focused Sales Representative who can identify business opportunities, understand customer needs and recommend suitable products and services. The successful candidate will conduct site visits and building surveys, prepare proposals and quotations, secure new business and develop lasting customer relationships. The role requires a practical understanding of customers’ operations, the ability to explain technical information clearly and a consistent record of achieving sales targets. Key Responsibilities Develop new business through scheduled sales calls, prospecting, lead follow-up and established marketing strategies. Build and maintain relationships with existing and prospective customers, identifying opportunities for products, services and service agreements. Assess customer needs and prepare sales strategies and formal sales plans to secure customer commitment. Conduct site visits and building surveys to gather information for suitable recommendations, proposals and quotations. Present proposals, secure sales and meet or exceed assigned sales targets. Maintain an active pipeline of proposals and opportunities to support sales quotas. Identify opportunities for Quoted Work Orders, Test and Inspect services, Monitoring services and Preventative Maintenance contracts. Coordinate service sales involving moves, additions and changes for assigned accounts, and manage customer agreement renewals as required. Maintain regular customer contact to address requirements, support customer satisfaction and encourage long-term loyalty. Work closely with the Service and Inspection Department and other teams to coordinate customer requirements and generate leads for services, equipment and system upgrades. Record customer interactions, prospecting activities and sales progress accurately in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) database. Prepare and submit sales reports, requisitions, invoices, delivery notes, expense documents, competitor activity reports and related correspondence accurately and on time. Monitor prequalification and tender processes as required. Contribute to the objectives of the Company’s Annual Sales Plan and support market penetration and business development. Follow Company policies, procedures, internal controls and applicable safety requirements. Perform other related duties as required. Qualifications and Experience An Associate Degree in Business or a related field. At least five years of sales experience, with demonstrated evidence of consistently meeting sales targets. Training in Customer Service. A Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management, a Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM) qualification or a related qualification would be an asset. Knowledge and Technical Skills Ability to understand the Company’s operations, products, services and target market. Ability to assess customer requirements and explain technical information clearly. Demonstrated ability to prepare Business Development Plans and Sales Reports. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Ability to maintain accurate customer and sales records using a CRM database. Skills and Competencies Sales and customer needs assessment: Understand customers’ operations, explore broader requirements and identify suitable sales opportunities. Relationship building: Develop productive relationships with customers, colleagues and other stakeholders. Communication: Communicate clearly and professionally, verbally and in writing, including when presenting technical information. Customer service: Provide responsive, reliable service and follow through on customer commitments. Adaptability and emotional intelligence: Adjust the sales approach to customers’ needs and responses, recognise their concerns and build personal connections. Problem solving: Review information, assess options and recommend practical solutions. Organisation and time management: Prioritise sales calls, site visits, proposals and follow-up activities to meet deadlines and targets. Professionalism and integrity: Demonstrate sound judgement, ethical conduct, appropriate appearance and composure in challenging situations. Safety awareness: Follow applicable workplace and trade safety laws, regulations, standards and practices. REF: J.C Ref: SR-20261031-JC Apply Now
